h:
您是一名基础用户，只想要一个简单易懂的工作流程，并且看起来不像您不小心启动了异星工厂吗？此工作流程适合您！它可以通过总共五个节点生成高质量且高度可定制的图像。

依赖项：

  • 效率节点

    • https://github.com/jags111/efficiency-nodes-comfyui

    • 这些做实际的工作。 LoRA Stacker 允许您设置多个 LoRA 和权重，并将其传递到加载器节点。加载程序接受模型和 VAE，以及提示和基本参数。它与升级器节点一起将数据传递到 KSampler 节点，该节点运行采样和升级，并在完成后生成预览图像网格。

  • 红三

    • https://github.com/rgthree/rgthree-comfy

    • 该包用于重新路由节点，这使得节点链接更容易查看和理解。

请注意，默认情况下，最后的保存节点是压缩的，因为没有理由让它一直展开。如果您不想自动保存所有生成的图像，只需右键单击保存节点并选择绕过即可。

此工作流程不支持 Adetailer、ControlNet 或修复，因为它的设计目的是让初学者尽可能简单。

o.en:
Are you a basic user who just wants a no-frills workflow that's easy to follow and doesn't look like you accidentally launched Factorio? This workflow is for you! It can produce high quality and greatly customizable images with a grand total of five nodes.

Dependencies:

  • Efficiency Nodes

    • https://github.com/jags111/efficiency-nodes-comfyui

    • These do the actual work. A LoRA Stacker lets you set multiple LoRAs and weights, which get passed to the loader node. The loader accepts the models and VAE, as well as the prompts and basic parameters. This, along with the upscaler node, passes data to the KSampler node, which runs both sampling and upscaling, and produces a grid of preview images when done.

  • rgthree

    • https://github.com/rgthree/rgthree-comfy

    • This package is used for the Reroute nodes, which make the node links much easier to see and understand.

Note that the save node at the very end is compressed by default, since there's no reason to leave it expanded all the time. If you don't want to automatically save all generated images, just right-click the save node and select Bypass.

This workflow does not support Adetailer, ControlNet, or inpainting, as it's designed to be as simple as possible for beginners.
